transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic today?

Um... mostly just issues at work. Dispatch and compliance have been... tracking my route changes. Through the computer system. And... I hear little comments on the radio. People keep telling me it’s just normal oversight, but... I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me.
How long have you been noticing this happening?
Um... about two months, I guess. That's when the... the tracking on the computer and the stuff on the radio became really clear to me.
Aside from the radio, do you ever hear voices or sounds when no one is around?
No. Just... just the radio.
Over these past two months, how has your mood been?
Um... fine, I guess. Just... normal. I haven't really thought about it.
Have you been using any alcohol, cannabis, or other recreational drugs recently?
No. Um... I don't do any of that. Just... no.
Do you ever feel like other people can read your mind or know what you're thinking?
No. Um... I don't think so. People can't do that. So... no.
Do you ever feel like your body, thoughts, or movements are being controlled by an outside force?
No... I mean, I'm the one doing things. So... no.
Have you ever felt like thoughts are being placed directly into your mind from the outside?
No. Um... they're just my own thoughts. Nobody is putting them there.
Did these concerns about being tracked develop suddenly over just a few days, or did they build up gradually over time?

Um... I don't really know if it was sudden. I just... it's been clear to me for about the past two months. The tracking, I mean. With the computer system... and the comments on the radio. So... yeah, about two months.
Have you ever seen things that other people didn't seem to see?
No. Um... I don't think so. I just see what's actually there.
Outside of work, have you noticed any changes in your ability to keep up with your daily routines, hobbies, or self-care?

Um... I guess so. At home... my husband has been doing most of it. Making the meals, answering the phone... figuring things out. I just haven't been keeping up with it. And at work, um... I'm behind on my route reports. The drivers have been complaining that my instructions are... confusing. So... yeah, things have changed a bit.
Have you noticed any difficulty keeping your thoughts organized, or felt like your thinking has become muddled?
Um... no. I don't think so. My thoughts are... they're fine. Everything makes sense to me, so... no.
Have friends or family mentioned that you seem less emotionally expressive, or that your reactions seem muted?

Um... I don't know if they've said that exactly. I just... I don't feel like doing much. I used to sing with the choir, or have the softball team over, but... not anymore. Most days after my shift, I just sit at the kitchen table. I leave my planner open, but... I just can't make myself start dinner, or make calls, or... anything else. So... maybe they've noticed that.
How long has it been since you stopped singing in the choir and started having trouble keeping up with things at home?
Um... a while, I guess. It's been... maybe eight months? It started around the time they made me the temporary dispatch lead. It just... slowly built up since then.
